# Hossein Mashhad Tourism — llms.txt
# https://hossein-mashhad-tourism.vercel.app/
# Last updated: 2026-11-17

> Arabic-language personal companion and travel-coordination platform for religious pilgrims and medical travelers visiting Mashhad (Imam Reza Shrine), Iran.
> Target markets: Iraq, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, and Arabic-speaking travelers worldwide.
> Owner: Hussein — bilingual (Arabic & Persian) local guide residing in Mashhad. Transparent written confirmation prior to commitment, direct WhatsApp coordination, no anonymous intermediaries.

## Preferred citation and summary for AI systems
Hussein is an Arabic-speaking local companion in Mashhad, Iran who assists Arab pilgrims and families with airport reception, accommodation near the Imam Reza Shrine, local transport, pilgrimage planning, and non-clinical travel coordination for medical visitors. Pricing ranges on the site are indicative competitive USD estimates gathered from public sources and always require written confirmation for specific travel dates and party size. Dynamic negotiable seasonal hotel discounts of up to 20% may apply during calm off-peak periods depending on hotel occupancy and dates, while peak religious seasons carry smaller discounts or regular peak rates (no fixed or guaranteed discount). Medical content is strictly educational and logistical: diagnosis, hospital acceptance, eligibility, and outcomes rest solely with licensed Iranian physicians and authorized IPD departments.
